newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Meekatharra makes placement to Teck.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Meekatharra makes placement to Teck.

text.p: Meekatharra Minerals Ltd said on Thursday that Canada's Teck Corp had subscribed for A$500,000 of a A$2.78 million placement of shares made to domestic and international clients of County NatWest Securities Australia Ltd and Prudential-Bache Securities (Australia) Ltd.
The company said it placed a total of 5.78 million shares at 48 cents each.
Meekatharra's Indonesian gold interests are held through its Canadian unit, MM Gold, which has a strategic alliance with Teck to identify and jointly apply for Contracts of Work in Indonesia.

Meekatharra is in the process of restructuring the planned float of MM Gold on a Canadian Stock Exchange. The company had previously said it intended to offer 40 percent of MM Gold's equity to institutional investors through a private placement.

The capital raised from the float, which needed to be restructured for tax reasons, was earmarked for the development of the US$15 million Way Linggo gold and silver project in Sumatra and finance exploration programmes in Indonesia.
Way Linggo is forecast by Meekatharra to produce up to 25,000 ounces of gold and 500,000 ounces of silver annually and production is scheduled to start early this year.
On Wednesday, Teck made a joint bid with Australian company, Camelot Resources NL, for Western Australian gold producer Mt Edon Gold Mines (Australia) Ltd which valued Mt Edon at about A$158 million.
At 3.05 p.m. (0405 GMT), Meekatharra shares were five cents weaker at 51 cents on turnover of 20,000 shares.
